note: tiffcp's InkNames-copy block (tools/tiffcp.c) reads `ninks` directly from the attacker-controlled TIFFTAG_NUMBEROFINKS directory tag via `TIFFGetField(in, TIFFTAG_NUMBEROFINKS, &ninks)` (line 764), then `while (ninks > 1) { cp = strchr(cp, '\0'); cp++; inknameslen += (strlen(cp) + 1); ninks--; }` (lines 769-773) walks `cp` through the TIFFTAG_INKNAMES buffer exactly `ninks - 1` times, with no check anywhere between the TIFFGetField() read and the loop that `ninks` actually matches the number of NUL-separated strings present in that buffer. A NumberOfInks value larger than the true InkNames string count walks `cp`/`strchr`/`strlen` past the end of the buffer.
